description: Every narrative assertion from the SaleSonic Data Requirements document that MUST be present in the SaleSonic personas app. Phrases are normalised (straight quotes, ASCII hyphens, single spaces). The coverage test asserts each phrase is present in the demo dataset, and that the dataset invents nothing the document does not support.
normalisation: NFKC; curly quotes -> straight; en/em dash -> hyphen; arrows -> "->"; currency symbol stripped when matching; whitespace collapsed; case-insensitive
